responsibility: This header publishes the mc-boot runtime's procedural wrapper around the host termios API. It defines an opaque termios_TERMIOS handle together with enumerations that normalize terminal control characters and input/output/control/local flag names, and declares the operations for allocating and freeing a termios state object, getting and setting terminal attributes and baud rates, switching to raw mode, performing drain/flush/flow-control operations, and reading or updating individual flags and control characters for terminal file descriptors.
